semiconductor_relevance: High — Daiichi Jitsugyo provides a range of advanced manufacturing equipment and automation solutions specifically designed for semiconductor factories.
summary: Daiichi Jitsugyo specializes in manufacturing equipment for both front-end and back-end semiconductor processes, including advanced packaging. They offer a variety of automated material handling systems (AMHS) and solutions that enhance factory automation, including hybrid systems that can accommodate older equipment.
capabilities: Automated material handling systems (AMHS) including AMRs and OHTs
Surface modification technology using oxygen radicals
Laser wet processing equipment for brittle materials
